{{Short description|Football tournament}}
The '''2024 Copa Sudamericana group stage''' was played from 2 April to 8 June 2024.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Fixture-Sudamericana_Fase-de-Grupos-CS-2024_19-03-2024.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2024 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 19/03/2024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 March 2024|access-date=19 March 2024}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide 16 of the 24 places in the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2024-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=13 December 2023|access-date=17 March 2024}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 18 March 2024, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/sorteo-de-fase-de-grupos-en-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2024/|title=Sorteo de Fase de Grupos en la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=Group Stage Draw in the 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=15 March 2024|access-date=17 March 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/conformacion-de-grupos-para-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2024/|title=¡El camino a la Gran Conquista!|trans-title=The path to the Great Conquest!|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 March 2024|access-date=18 March 2024}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 18 December 2023 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Ranking-CONMEBOL-2024-Final-1.pdf|title=Ranking de Clubes de la CONMEBOL 2024|trans-title=2024 CONMEBOL Clubs Ranking|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 December 2023|access-date=17 March 2024|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2014–2023.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2013 and 2002–2013 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The four losers of the [[2024 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|Copa Libertadores third stage]] were seeded into Pot 4. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners of each group advanced to the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]], whilst the runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]] of the final stages.<section end=Format />
